title: Real-Time Risk Control Effects of Digital Compliance Dashboards: An Empirical Study Across Multiple Enterprises Using Process Mining, Anomaly Detection, and Interrupt Time Series
content: Based on 34 cross-border project logs (ERP/work orders/approval flows) from 2018 to 2023 at Aiku Communications and multiple multinational corporations, this study employs process mining (Heuristics/α-Miner) + compliance consistency metrics to identify process deviations; Combined LSTM-Autoencoder/Isolation Forest for transaction and process anomaly detection; evaluated immediate and sustained effects of the digital compliance dashboard deployment using Interrupted Time Series (ITS) and Double Difference analysis. Results: Compliance issue detection efficiency +42%, process transparency score +29%, operational risk incident rate −36%; Risk early warning advanced by 5.6 days on average; anomaly detection achieved AUC 0.87 and PR-AUC 0.62, with a net uplift of +12.7 pct within 90 days post-deployment.
